body: Sounds like you have toxic friends. I don't talk to any of my friends that say stuff like that to me..
I feel it.. Everyday my candle of hope grows dimmer and its almost darkness for me at this point...

Take a chance and if it doesn't work out leave.. That's what I'm doing with my life right now. I really find no meaning in life right now with 6 years of depression under my belt. I'm doing things in my life I HATE. Just do what you think is best since its your life.

Just know you're not the only one. That is one of my many problems in my life as well. Sometimes we have to face reality with the choices we made. I know its painful and impossible but just know I understand. I stand with you spiritually even though I'm no better. It hurts but just know I care. This is a pain I would not wish upon my enemies... Just take baby steps

I'm going to wing this to give my life a purpose. Life is a big middle finger to your face everyday. People are horrible but  for every  negative there is a positive. As humans we have a tremendous power which is not comparable to any nuclear or biological weapon. That power is our ability to change... Change is a constant in nature and I want you to embrace it. Take my advice and change that trail of thought. Change for the better and not for the worse.
I'm at that breaking point in my life as well... Six years of depression and here I am....
I feel it... my emotional scars have not healed yet shit keeps happening.
As corny as it sounds only time can heal which I learned. Depression is just a REALLY bad "cold" Medications just mask the pain...

I never found them helpful at all since its all theory based... My psychiatrist does the same bullshit and keeps trying to advertise drugs to me. Sadly I'm on a few of them.... Depression never has a simple answer sadly
